desc:
BE QUIET 🎙️

You wake up in an old house and need to find a way out. But BE QUIET! He will hear you if you mess up...

🎧 Headphones and high graphics recommended.
⚠️ Contains jumpscares, loud sounds, and tense atmosphere.
🎙️ Designed for voice chat / microphone input.


❓ Will you escape without being caught?
